seo.meta_title: What Is the In-N-Out Secret Menu? (2026)
seo.meta_description: In-N-Out's secret menu includes Animal Style, Protein Style, 3x3 and 4x4, Flying Dutchman and the Neapolitan shake. Here's how to order each one.
seo.h1: What Is the In-N-Out Secret Menu?

question: What Is the In-N-Out Secret Menu?
quick_answer: The In-N-Out secret menu is a set of off-menu ways to customize your order that the staff all know. The most famous are Animal Style (mustard-grilled patty, extra spread, grilled onions and pickles), Protein Style (burger wrapped in lettuce instead of a bun), the 3x3 and 4x4 (three or four patties), the Flying Dutchman (two patties and cheese, no bun) and the Neapolitan shake. In-N-Out calls it the 'Not-So-Secret Menu'.
key_facts: Animal Style: mustard-cooked patty, extra spread, grilled onions, pickles
Protein Style: burger wrapped in lettuce, no bun
3x3 / 4x4: three or four patties and slices of cheese
Flying Dutchman: two patties and two slices of cheese, no bun
Neapolitan shake: chocolate, vanilla and strawberry blended together

body.heading: The famous burger options
body.text: The best-known secret-menu item is Animal Style, where the patty is cooked in mustard and the burger comes with extra spread, grilled onions and pickles. You can also get Animal Style Fries (fries topped with cheese, spread and grilled onions). Protein Style swaps the bun for a lettuce wrap, a popular low-carb choice.

body.heading: Bigger (and smaller) builds
body.text: In-N-Out lets you stack patties: a 3x3 has three patties and three slices of cheese, and a 4x4 has four of each. The Flying Dutchman is two patties and two slices of cheese with no bun and nothing else, for pure meat and cheese. You can also just add or remove toppings freely.

body.heading: Drinks and the 'Not-So-Secret Menu'
body.text: On the shake side, the Neapolitan blends chocolate, vanilla and strawberry together. In-N-Out openly acknowledges most of these orders on its website as the 'Not-So-Secret Menu', so you can order them confidently; the staff know them all.

faqs.q: What is Animal Style at In-N-Out?
faqs.a: Animal Style means the patty is grilled in mustard and the burger comes with extra spread, grilled onions and pickles. Animal Style Fries add cheese, spread and grilled onions to the fries.
Protein Style is any In-N-Out burger wrapped in lettuce instead of a bun, a popular low-carb option.
A 4x4 is a burger with four beef patties and four slices of cheese. A 3x3 has three of each.
